signature.name: VTask.IsNatEquiv
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> [Preorder ι] -> {F : ι → Type u_4} -> {X : ι → Type u_5} -> (f : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → F j → F i) -> {s : Set ι} -> (equiv : (j : ↑s) → F ↑j ≃ InverseSystem.piLT X ↑j) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: IsNatEquiv is a universally quantified Prop; it is satisfied when all naturality squares commute and unsatisfied otherwise. No junk-value or boundary conventions are needed because the definition is total and there are no out-of-domain inputs.

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] {F : ι → Type*} {X : ι → Type*} (f : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → F j → F i) {s : Set ι} (equiv : (j : ↑s) → F ↑j ≃ InverseSystem.piLT X ↑j), VTask.IsNatEquiv f equiv)

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] {F : ι → Type*} {X : ι → Type*} (f : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → F j → F i) {s t : Set ι} (hst : t ⊆ s) (equiv : (j : ↑s) → F ↑j ≃ InverseSystem.piLT X ↑j), VTask.IsNatEquiv f equiv → VTask.IsNatEquiv f (fun j => equiv ⟨j.1, hst j.2⟩)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] {F : ι → Type*} {X : ι → Type*} (f : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → F j → F i) {s : Set ι} (equiv : (j : ↑s) → F ↑j ≃ InverseSystem.piLT X ↑j), VTask.IsNatEquiv f equiv ↔ ∀ (k j : ↑s) (h : k.1 ≤ j.1) (x : F j.1), (equiv k) (f h x) = InverseSystem.piLTProj h ((equiv j) x)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] {F : ι → Type*} {X : ι → Type*} (f : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → F j → F i) {s : Set ι} (equiv : (j : ↑s) → F ↑j ≃ InverseSystem.piLT X ↑j), VTask.IsNatEquiv f equiv → ∀ (k j : ↑s) (h : k.1 ≤ j.1) (y : InverseSystem.piLT X j.1), f h ((equiv j).symm y) = (equiv k).symm (InverseSystem.piLTProj h y)
